mapper.insert: INSERT INTO album_photo (title, description, url, location, photo_date, tags, album_name, sort_order, status, is_public) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{url}, #{location}, #{photoDate}, #{tags}, #{albumName}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{isPublic})
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM album_photo
AND status = #{status}
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{tag}, tags)
AND is_public = 1
AND album_name = #{albumName}
AND (album_name IS NULL OR album_name = '')
ORDER BY sort_order DESC, create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT tags FROM album_photo WHERE status = 1 AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags != ''
AND is_public = 1

SELECT DISTINCT album_name FROM album_photo WHERE status = 1 AND album_name IS NOT NULL AND album_name != ''
AND is_public = 1
